study type: Global Survey/Analysis of Clinical Trial Registries
outcome: Number of registered clinical trials for pharmacological interventions in pregnancy (PDTs)
Nature of PDTs (e.g., focus areas, new drug development vs. repurposing, inclusion of pharmacokinetic analysis)
Percentage of all active registered studies that are PDTs
cohort: All active clinical trials (168,826 identified in 2013-2014) registered in 16 WHO-certified clinical trial registries worldwide.
finding: The study unequivocally demonstrates a marked under-representation of medication development, evaluation, and safety trials in pregnancy, with only 0.32% (534) of all active registered studies being Pregnancy Drug Trials (PDTs).
